items.title: Wendell Brunious interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 16, 2000 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: Because Jerome was just — years and years ago he recorded a record, before CDs, an album with Gino Vanelli, where he played soprano.

ctx.x: Yeah it was pretty seamless. I think it’s just Watrous. He just can hear man. That guy can — man can he play some sassy trombone. Boy that was such a great experience. Because Jerome was just — years and years ago he recorded a record, before CDs, an album with Gino Vanelli, where he played soprano.
